brief:
Dr. Ismail al-Thawabta, director general of the government media office, issued an urgent appeal to the international community, donor agencies, and local bodies to unite efforts and provide immediate assistance to protect displaced families in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. Al-Thawabta stressed the danger posed by the approaching winter season to Palestinians living in displacement across the territory.

The call for coordinated action underscores mounting concerns over conditions facing the displaced population. Winter weather threatens families already facing shortages of shelter, fuel, and basic supplies amid the ongoing humanitarian crisis gripping Gaza.
